title: Highlighter marks
summary: Key words get a flat background block like a marker pen, so emphasis comes from color behind the text instead of weight or size.
use_when: Pointing at the one phrase that carries the pitch; labeling sections.
avoid_when: Long body copy. More than one mark per screen dilutes it.
